full_judgment: 9. The defendant No. 6 namely, United Sea Transport Co Ltd, has contested the suit by filing written statement. The defendant No. 6 has stated that the suit is not maintainable in its present form and the plaintiff has no cause of action. The plaintiff has filed this present suit with a malafide and on vexatious pleas to harass the defendants the suit is also bad for mis-joinder and non-joinder of parties. Moreover, the defendant No. 6 has contended that the suit is not maintainable under the Admiralty Jurisdiction and is barred under the principle of waiver, acquiescence and estoppel. This defendant has categorically denied that the plaintiff had or has ever supplied any spare parts and/or provision as contended by the plaintiff. The defendant No. 6 has stated that since the plaintiff did not supply any spare parts, provisions and render laundry service etc, they are not at all entitled to US $ 22,631.80. Further, the defendant No. 6 has stated that they are the shipping agent of the defendant No. 1 vessel. They never forwarded any requisition for the said items to be supplied on board the vessel by the plaintiff. The plaintiff is required to obtain endorsement on the shipping export bill from the Customs Authority against the supply of those requisitioned items. Further, the defendant No. 6 has stated that no supply was made in presence of Customs Boarding Officer and no shipping bill/export bill was endorsed/sealed and signed by the Master of the vessel, and the Customs Boarding Officer. The plaintiff presented no Customs shipping bill/export bill along with supporting documents to the defendant No. 6, the shipping agent. The plaintiff was as required under law to present those shipping bill/export bill to this defendant for verification, if any supply was made on board the vessel. Mainly on the aforesaid pleas the defendant No. 6 fully denied the claim of the plaintiff.
